parole.testo: Ottoman Turkish دشمه (deşme, “an opening or a thing dug into”), the resultative noun from Ottoman Turkish دشمك (deşmek, “to cleave, to puncture”), from Proto-Turkic *teĺ- (“to make holes”).

parole.significato: cantaloupe (Cucumis melo var. cantalupo and its fruit)
parole.testo: Borrowed from Ottoman Turkish قاون (kavun, “melon”), from Proto-Turkic *kagun.
